CHAPTER 6 · ITEM 08 / 12

Unit taxes and incidence

Drawing a unit tax畫單位稅

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Draw or interpret a tax on sellers as an upward supply shift, and a tax on buyers as a downward demand shift, by the tax per unit.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

向賣方收稅，可在買方價格座標把供給上移 t；向買方收稅，可在賣方價格座標把需求下移 t。結果均是 Pb 比 Ps 高 t。

A tax on sellers shifts supply vertically up by t in buyer-price terms. A tax on buyers shifts demand vertically down by t in seller-price terms. Both create the same gap Pb−Ps=t under the standard model.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：If sellers need net $10 to supply a quantity, a $3 tax means buyers must pay $13 for that quantity. 淨收十元需要買方付十三元。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

A $4 unit tax on sellers shifts supply by how much vertically? 賣方每件四元稅？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
